name: kumbh-2027
description: An independent, non-governmental information service for pilgrims attending the Nashik–Trimbakeshwar Simhastha Kumbh Mela 2027. It surfaces **every** auspicious bathing day - not only the three headline Amrit Snan dates - with a transparent, labelled crowd **estimate** and plain-language significance, so a pilgrim can choose the day that fits them instead of everyone converging on the same three.
